statement: The University of Florida blueberry breeding programme publishes measured values for Farthing of firmness of 212 to 263 g/mm with an average of 227, average berry weight of 2.2 g, average diameter of 17.7 mm and average soluble solids of 11.8 degrees Brix. The firmness figures use the programme's own g/mm compression index and are not directly comparable with firmness figures produced by other methods.
